content.short: RareBetSports is a high-performance Web3 sports prediction and fantasy platform powered by secure on-chain oracles.
content.description: RareBetSports is a next-generation decentralized sports prediction and fantasy platform built to provide transparency and provable fairness to the virtual gaming world. Primarily launching on the Monad blockchain, the platform utilizes its proprietary RareLink oracle engine to bring real-time sports data—including odds, injuries, and lineups—directly on-chain. This ensures that every prediction and payout is settled through transparent smart contracts without the need for centralized intermediaries. Designed for high-speed engagement, RareBetSports allows users to create player prediction parlays.
content.meta: RareBetSports offers on-chain sports prediction and fantasy gaming with real-time oracles. Discover RareBetSports on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
